verdict.justification: The project aims to develop a web-based system for managing the supply chain in production and storage areas for the company Agregados Éxito. The focus is on efficient management of supply operations, which aligns with Information Systems primary category. The secondary category, Web Applications, is assigned due to the development of a web-based system.
